mission_06: Excellent! You have successfully applied Linear Discriminant Analysis for supervised dimensionality reduction. You learned how LDA uses class labels to find components that maximize class separability, unlike PCA which ignores labels. The explained variance ratio in LDA shows how much of the between-class variance each component captures. LDA is particularly effective when classes are linearly separable and the data follows approximately normal distributions within each class. Use LDA when you have labeled data and your goal is classification-oriented dimensionality reduction.
